units.source_text: 二女公子想道：“此二人皆已供职多年，对姐姐都很忠诚，岂知今已如此变心，不复谈起她了。

en.t: The Second Princess thought, "These two have served for many years and were both very loyal to my elder sister, yet who could have known that they would now change their hearts like this and no longer even speak of her.

units.source_text: 世间人情浇薄，甚可恨也。”

en.t: Human feeling in this world is so shallow and cold; it is truly hateful."
She even lost the will to speak.
